relevance_note: Supplementary Table 2 gives individual-level data, including LAMP2 variants, for the 15 patients ('Fifteen patients with genetically confirmed DD were recruited retrospectively'), and Supplementary Table 3 summarises 36 previously published Danon disease patients.
method_note: Python script (scratch) transcribed Supplementary Table 2 (own cohort, 15 patients) and Supplementary Table 3 (literature review, 36 patients) row by row; spans are slices of the raw table rows from the patient label through the relevant cell, so the own-cohort spans include the table's padding spaces. I checked transcribed values against the tables. Labels: own cohort 'patient N' with footnote markers # and § dropped (printed as e.g. 'patient 11#§'); literature rows labelled 'Supplementary Table 3 #N' from the bare case number in the 'Case (reference)' column, with the reference number and the supplementary reference-list entry copied into source_reference_in_review. Prior reports of own-cohort patients: footnote # marks 14 patients (all except patient 10) as previously reported by Wei et al (doi:10.1148/radiol.2021203996, main-text ref 9); footnote § marks patients 11 and 13 as the same patients as in Liu et al (doi:10.1093/eurheartj/ehr438). source_reference_in_review left 'not reported' for own-cohort patients because they are described first-hand; the per-patient re-report markers are recorded here and in publications. Variant values are de-escaped from Markdown (e.g. printed 'c.1057C\>T' recorded as 'c.1057C>T'); 'c.808_809 insG' kept with its space. Gene symbol is not printed per row (column 'Gene mutation site'); LAMP2 taken from the Introduction. No variant rows for the 36 literature patients (Supplementary Table 3 prints no variants and does not tie a LAMP2 variant to each). '+'/'-' cells recorded observed/excluded using the table notes' definitions ('+ indicates the presence of the feature; - indicates the absence of the feature'), quoted as a second span; NA cells not reported. Symptom codes 1/2/3 in Supplementary Table 2 decoded from its note. HCM recorded as left ventricular hypertrophy on the checklist; footnotes * (LV dilatation) and † (systolic LV dysfunction) and DCM recorded as 'dilated or hypokinetic left ventricle'. LV phenotype 'Normal' (literature #4 and #10) recorded as left ventricular hypertrophy excluded (D-27). Outcome 'HF' recorded as heart failure; 'Death' as deceased; 'Alive' as alive; 'HF' alone leaves vital status not reported. Age at ECG (the only age given per patient) was not recorded as age at last evaluation, because outcomes such as death came later; it is not onset or diagnosis age either. Recruitment from 'six tertiary centers in China' not recorded as ethnicity/country of origin. Fragmented-QRS counts of 0 leads not recorded as excluded (0 not defined as absence); literature #4 (0 leads, score 2) has no f-QRS row because the two cells disagree; #18 has 1 lead but score 0 (recorded observed with both values in detail). Contradictions/inconsistencies: (1) Figure 4 describes a 16-year-old male with 'c.936G > A' and f-QRS score 3, which matches no table row (patient 10 is 16 years with c.963G>A and score 6); not linked to anyone. (2) Figure 5 describes a 17-year-old male with syncope, 'c.35C > A', 12 leads and score 15: the variant and 12 leads match patient 5 (24 years, DCM, symptom 2 only) but the age and syncope match patient 3 (17 years, c.29_35dupCGGGCTC, 11 leads); not linked to anyone. (3) Table 1 gives syncope '6 (47)' although 6/15 is 40%. (4) Supplementary Table 2 note defines 'VCD' while the table prints 'VCB'; recorded as 'VCB'. (5) Supplementary Table 3 summary row gives other arrhythmia 6/15 for the own cohort, while Supplementary Table 2 lists 7 patients with a non-NA entry. No stacked (' / ') per-patient cells were used; the stacked cells are only in Supplementary Table 1 (scanner protocols) and the summary rows of Supplementary Table 3.
